periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented vertically with a slight inward tilt at the inferior pole.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a significantly high height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visual center is situated in the upper half of the patch with a pronounced downward tapering toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad; dark pigmentation fully covers the visible lateral shoulder and flank regions.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant separation between the ear regions, spanning the width of the cranial vault.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and smoothly rounded curvature at the superior boundary of both pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Ventral fur exhibits a prominent yellowish-brown chromatic staining relative to the white fur of the cranial and facial regions.
